tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search the public pages and research notes on excessionlabs.ai. Returns titles, URLs and one-line summaries.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one public page of excessionlabs.ai as Markdown. Use a path from search_site or llms.txt.

tools.name: how_to_contact
tools.description: Return the ways a person can contact Excession Labs: the request form, email, and the request_security_test tool for agents.

tools.name: request_security_test
tools.description: Send a request for a security test (web application, API, multi-tenant SaaS isolation or AI application) to Excession Labs on behalf of a person who asked for it. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_security_test" references sensitive artifacts (password, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Send a request for a security test (web application, API, multi-tenant SaaS isolation or AI application) to Excession Labs on behalf of a person who asked for i…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site · Private data: how_to_contact, request_security_test · Public sink: how_to_contact, request_security_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site · Private data: how_to_contact, request_security_test · Public sink: how_to_contact, request_security_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
